world.name: Frosted Keynote

decision.declined: Retrospective roll (numbered wayfinding conflicts with the no-kicker craft floor)

dosageRules: backdrop-filter (saturate(180%) blur(20px)) is spent ONLY on the header capsule; content sheets are translucent-without-blur at .88-.9 alpha (sub-second first paint + GPU budget)
Glass is chrome, sheets are solid: pills and chips sitting ON a sheet use --pill-line/--pill-bg (ghost treatment), never --glass-* tokens or blur
Gold (--gold/--gold-wash) is spent on exactly one subject: the award metric (hero award fact, metric-chips, award tiles, return badge)
Alarm (--alarm) is spent only on the diagram's blocker node
One blue accent owns action, links, focus, and the timeline spine; aurora hues live only in the field, stage washes, selection, and progress bar
Dark tokens are written twice in app.css: the prefers-color-scheme block guarded by :not([data-theme="light"]) AND :root[data-theme="dark"] - change both
One shared ease-out clock cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for reveals and hover lifts; reveals animate translate/scale, never transform (reserved for hover lifts)
bannedPatterns: Numbered section wayfinding (declined at direction time)
Stat-card bands (facts are one woven mono line)
Unconditional opacity: 0 or any hiding rule not gated behind .js-motion from motion.js
IntersectionObserver thresholds > 0 (blanks tall sections on phones)
Visual design on the printed CV - it stays ATS-plain by product rule
Aurora field or reading-progress bar reaching paper (both hidden in @media print)

display.purpose: Hero headline only; each line in its own clipping box for the one-time unmask.

body.purpose: All prose, capped at the 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Geist Mono uppercase labels, data, and the hero facts line; carries all numerals with tabular-nums.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: Every content sheet: contact step, mid lift, wide blue-tinted atmosphere.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Header capsule and the diagram stage.

shadows.name: glass-highlight
shadows.purpose: Inner top edge that says real glass; glass chrome only.

shadows.name: aurora-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover-only halo under buttons, chips (0 6px 18px), and study links; never at rest.

motion.name: ease-clock
motion.purpose: The shared ease-out clock: reveals (.7s), stagger (.55s, 50ms/item), button and chip translate (.2-.22s).

motion.name: aurora-drift
motion.purpose: Three blobs phase in and out of alignment; gradients rasterize exactly once.

motion.name: reveal-property-rule
motion.purpose: transform is reserved for hover lifts so the individual properties compose with it.

motion.name: hero-guard
motion.value: sessionStorage heroPlayed=1; scrollY > 40; performance.now() > 1500ms boot deadline - any one skips and the hero is never armed
motion.purpose: Motion never replays over a reader; a skipped visitor gets the static hero, never armed-but-invisible.

motion.name: progress-bar
motion.purpose: Reading progress with no script and no markup; @supports guarded; hidden in print.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Header capsule wraps to two rows (radius 24px); scroll-margin-top 92px -> 216px.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Hero grid stacks; diagram body to one column, bridge rotates horizontal.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Timeline gains the 10.5rem right-aligned period column.

material.stage: linear-gradient(180deg, #101a2c, #0b1220) plus aurora radial washes; dark in both themes; colours local to the stage

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue capsule action; hover lifts 1px and throws the aurora glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.45rem; min-height:44px; padding:.6rem 1.35rem; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; font:inherit; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; background:var(--action-bg,#0066cc); color:var(--action-ink,#ffffff); transition: translate .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .22s ease, background-color .22s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--action-bg-hover,#0059b3); translate:0 -1px; box-shadow:0 10px 26px var(--aurora-glow,rgba(10,132,255,.14)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate:0 0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#0071e3); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.description: On-sheet ghost capsule: pill tokens, no blur; hover takes the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.45rem; min-height:44px; padding:.6rem 1.35rem; border-radius:999px; font:inherit; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--pill-line,rgba(0,0,0,.24)); background:var(--pill-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.7)); color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); transition: translate .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .22s ease, color .22s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:var(--accent,#0066cc); color:var(--accent,#0066cc); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#0071e3); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Glass Header Capsule
components.description: The one true glass: floating capsule with backdrop-filter, deepening when content scrolls beneath (add the is-scrolled class).
components.html:
Bahaa Aldeen Mohamed

components.css: .ds-capsule { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:.75rem; min-height:56px; padding:.35rem .4rem .35rem 1.1rem; border-radius:999px; background:var(--glass-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.58)); border:1px solid var(--glass-line,rgba(255,255,255,.65)); box-shadow:var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.08),0 12px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.12)), var(--glass-highlight,inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45)); backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur,saturate(180%) blur(20px)); -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur,saturate(180%) blur(20px)); transition: background-color .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease; } .ds-capsule.is-scrolled { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.58)) 72%, var(--paper,#f5f5f7)); } .ds-capsule__name { font-weight:600; font-size:.98rem; letter-spacing:-.01em; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-capsule__nav { display:flex; gap:.15rem; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-capsule__nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 .85rem; border-radius:999px; color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); text-decoration:none; font-size:.92rem; transition: color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-capsule__nav a:hover { color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink,#1d1d1f) 7%, transparent); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: 44px circle holding both drawn SVG icons (1.6 stroke); which shows is CSS state, so it can never diverge from the palette. Add class ds-dark to preview the dark-state icon.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch theme"><svg class="ds-icon-sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"></circle><path d="M12 2v2m0 16v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41m11.32 11.32 1.41 1.41M2 12h2m16 0h2M4.93 19.07l1.41-1.41m11.32-11.32 1.41-1.41"></path></svg><svg class="ds-icon-moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display:grid; place-items:center; width:44px; height:44px; padding:0; color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(0,0,0,.1)); border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer; transition: color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color:var(--accent,#0066cc); border-color:var(--accent,#0066cc); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#0066cc) 8%, transparent); } .ds-theme-toggle svg { width:18px; height:18px; } .ds-theme-toggle .ds-icon-sun { display:none; } .ds-theme-toggle .ds-icon-moon { display:block; } .ds-theme-toggle.ds-dark .ds-icon-sun { display:block; } .ds-theme-toggle.ds-dark .ds-icon-moon { display:none; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: Scannable skill pill; the employer backing it sits in mono. Hover lifts and takes the accent border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.4rem; max-width:100%; min-height:32px; padding:.3rem .85rem; border:1px solid var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:999px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sheet-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9)) 80%, transparent); color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); font-size:.88rem; transition: translate .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { translate:0 -1px; border-color:var(--accent,#0066cc); box-shadow:0 6px 18px var(--aurora-glow,rgba(10,132,255,.14)); color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); } .ds-chip__where { font-family:var(--font-mono,"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:400; color:var(--ink-faint,#56575b); }

components.name: Evidenced Chip
components.description: An evidenced skill outranks an unevidenced one: ink weight, accent wash, accent-mixed border.
components.css: .ds-chip-evidenced { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.4rem; min-height:32px; padding:.3rem .85rem; border-radius:999px; font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); font-weight:600; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#0066cc) 38%, var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08))); background:var(--accent-wash,#e8f1fb); } .ds-chip-evidenced__where { font-family:var(--font-mono,"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:400; color:var(--ink-faint,#56575b); }

components.name: Award Metric Chip
components.description: The page's only gold: the squared 8px chip marking an award-earning metric.
components.css: .ds-metric-chip { display:inline-block; padding:.12rem .55rem; border-radius:8px; background:var(--gold-wash,#fbf3e2); color:var(--gold,#8a6116); font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem; }

components.name: Content Sheet
components.description: The content slab: translucent without blur, 16px radius, three-stage shadow. All dense text lives on one of these.
components.html:
Sheet title

Dense content floats as one rounded slab over the aurora field.
components.css: .ds-sheet { padding:clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3vw, 3.75rem) clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 3.25rem); background:var(--sheet-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9)); border:1px solid var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sheet,0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05),0 12px 32px rgba(16,24,40,.08),0 32px 80px rgba(10,80,160,.07)); } .ds-sheet__title { margin:0 0 .6rem; font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(1.85rem,1.15rem + 2.6vw,2.9rem); letter-spacing:-.028em; line-height:1.18; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); } .ds-sheet__lede { margin:0; max-width:68ch; font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.6; color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); }

components.name: Testimonial Tile
components.description: Solid quote tile - content, not chrome, so no blur rides under it. The quote mark is tall quiet punctuation in accent.
components.css: .ds-testimonial { margin:0; padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 1.25rem; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sheet-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9)) 70%, var(--paper,#f5f5f7)); border:1px solid var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:12px; } .ds-testimonial__quote { margin:0 0 1.1rem; } .ds-testimonial__quote p { margin:0; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); line-height:1.65; font-size:.98rem; } .ds-testimonial__quote p::before { content:"\201C"; display:block; font-family:var(--font-display,"Geist",sans-serif); font-size:2rem; line-height:.6; color:var(--accent,#0066cc); margin:.4rem 0 .7rem; } .ds-testimonial__by { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; } .ds-testimonial__avatar { flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; width:2.6rem; height:2.6rem; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-wash,#e8f1fb); color:var(--accent,#0066cc); font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-testimonial__who { display:grid; gap:.1rem; } .ds-testimonial__name { font-weight:600; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); } .ds-testimonial__meta { color:var(--ink-faint,#56575b); font-size:.86rem; }

components.css: .ds-stage { padding:1.4rem 1.5rem 1.6rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--aurora-blue,#0a84ff) 26%, rgba(255,255,255,.1)); border-radius:14px; background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 80% -10%, rgba(90,200,216,.16), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(120% 90% at 15% 110%, rgba(125,122,255,.14), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #101a2c, #0b1220); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07), var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.08),0 12px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.12)); } .ds-stage__label { margin:0 0 1.1rem; font-family:var(--font-mono,"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:.78rem; color:rgba(226,234,244,.6); } .ds-stage__body { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 2.25rem 1fr; gap:.85rem; align-items:stretch; } .ds-stage__panel { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.4rem; padding:.9rem .8rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.045); } .ds-stage__panel--before { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm,#b0432c) 42%, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); } .ds-stage__panel--after { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--aurora-teal,#5ac8d8) 46%, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); } .ds-node { padding:.42rem .55rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:6px; font-size:.72rem; color:rgba(226,234,244,.82); text-align:center; } .ds-node--blocker { border-style:dashed; border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm,#b0432c) 65%, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); color:#f4a08d; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm,#b0432c) 16%, transparent); } .ds-node--lead { border-color:var(--aurora-teal,#5ac8d8); color:var(--aurora-teal,#5ac8d8); font-weight:600; } .ds-bridge { width:2px; justify-self:center; align-self:stretch; background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--aurora-blue,#0a84ff), var(--aurora-teal,#5ac8d8)); border-radius:999px; }

narrative.overview: The site behaves like a native Apple app: one aurora-lit field behind everything, frosted glass reserved for chrome (the header capsule), and near-opaque rounded content sheets carrying every dense word. The world proves the candidate engineers calm — it refuses the category-default scrolling document and its sticky stat band. The dosage law governs everything: glass is chrome, sheets are solid. backdrop-filter is spent exactly once, on the header capsule; content sheets are translucent without blur, so a long page never holds a live GPU blur under the reader and first paint stays under a second — a product rule, not a preference. Motion is one orchestrated system on a shared ease-out clock: sections settle in as sheets, items stagger at 50ms per index, and the hero plays a single sequence — only for qualifying visits. Hiding is additive-only, gated behind .js-motion added by motion.js and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Aurora field: three transform-only radial-gradient blobs on one shared drift clock, present at first paint from the shell, outside the app runtime.
Frosted capsule header is the only real glass; sheets are translucent-without-blur slabs (16px radius).
One blue accent for action, links, and focus; gold spent on exactly one subject (awards); alarm red only for the diagram's blocker.
Geist + Geist Mono; negative tracking on every heading; mono carries all data and labels.
Capsule radii (999px) for all interactive chrome; hairlines, not boxes, separate content inside a sheet.
Reduced motion restores every hidden state; the printed CV sits outside this system entirely (ATS-plain by product rule).

rules.name: The Gold Is Singular Rule
rules.body: Gold is spent on exactly one subject — the award metric — and nowhere else. Its rarity is what makes the award land.

rules.name: The Twice-Written Rule
rules.body: Dark tokens are written twice in app.css — the guarded prefers-color-scheme block and the [data-theme="dark"] rule. Any token change is made in both places, always.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading — no kickers, no eyebrows, no numbered wayfinding. A section opens with its heading; attribution goes below it, in mono, in Ink Faint.

rules.name: The Two-Row Capsule Rule
rules.body: At 720px the capsule wraps to two rows inside one capsule (~200px tall); the mobile scroll-margin-top is 216px because of it. If the capsule is ever compacted, that 216px must shrink with it — the two are one decision.

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter (saturate(180%) blur(20px)) is spent exclusively on the header capsule. Content sheets are translucent without blur — render cost for nothing behind a .9-alpha sheet.

rules.name: The Scrolled-Depth Rule
rules.body: The capsule's glass deepens once content passes underneath (.is-scrolled at scrollY > 8) — state, not motion, so it runs regardless of reduced-motion.

dos: Do write any dark token change in both places — the guarded prefers-color-scheme block and the [data-theme="dark"] rule (The Twice-Written Rule).
Do gate every hiding rule behind .js-motion from motion.js, and restore every hidden state in the reduced-motion blocks.
Do keep backdrop-filter on chrome only; sheets stay translucent-without-blur at .88–.9 alpha.
Do keep gold on awards only, and the alarm on the diagram's blocker only.
Do keep 44px tap targets, the 68ch measure, and the 216px mobile scroll-margin in step with the two-row capsule.
Do keep the prerendered <div class="prerendered"> a direct child of #app, and mirror any header change in prerender.py's static_shell_header byte-for-byte.
Do carry final values in markup for anything a script counts or reveals — the static layer is the contract.
Do verify both themes at 390×844 and desktop width before calling anything done.
donts: Don't put kickers or eyebrows above headings, and don't add border-left accent stripes — both are below the craft floor (The No-Kicker Rule).
Don't build a stat-card band; the facts are one mono line woven into the hero.
Don't blur content, animate the aurora with anything but transform, or repaint the field after first raster.
Don't give the hero sequence to a visitor who scrolled, has seen it this session, or waited past the 1500ms boot deadline — and never arm without a proved restore path.
Don't raise the reveal IntersectionObserver threshold above 0 — a height-ratio threshold blanks tall sections on phones.
Don't print the design: the aurora and progress bar are hidden in print, and the printed CV (/cv document, print.css, EmptyLayout) stays deliberately ATS-plain outside this system by product rule.
Don't adopt numbered section wayfinding — the "Retrospective" discipline was declined at direction time; section numbers conflict with the No-Kicker Rule.
